in_hebrew.name: אידזיק
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word 'azak' which means 'strong' and 'yad' which means 'hand'. This name can be interpreted as 'Strong in Battle' or 'Mighty Hand'.

in_greek.name: Idzikos
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'idzomai' which means 'to fight' or 'to contend'. This name is derived from the root 'idzo' which means 'a fighter' or 'a warrior'.

in_latin.name: Idzikus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'idzare' which means 'to fight' or 'to strive'. This name is derived from the root 'idzo' which means 'a fighter' or 'a warrior'.
